summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The First Trust Nasdaq Food & Beverage ETF (FTXG) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Nasdaq US Smart Food & Beverage index. The fund follows a liquidity-selected, multi-factor-weighted index of US food & beverage companies. FTXG was launched on Sep 20, 2016 and is issued by First Trust.
infoTable: Nasdaq US Smart Food & Beverage Index

holdings.infoBox: FTXG is an equity ETF with a total of 31 individual holdings. The top holdings are The Coca-Cola Company stock at 8.42%, Mondelez International at 8.30%, The Kraft Heinz Company at 7.86%, PepsiCo at 7.84%, and Archer-Daniels-Midland Company at 6.36%.
